QUOTE: Without the opt-out it expands to `private_##member`, so a field written as `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(flags)` in a public header is actually named `private_flags` to any translation unit that includes it. ... Inside the library, `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(x)` expands to the real `x`.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer claims the rename applies to "any translation unit", and that the header and use site expand the same way in opted-out code. It never says that code defining MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS and an ordinary public-header consumer see different member names for the same struct.
